title: Introduction to Bioinformatics — Pre/Post Test
notes: No participant code; pairing uses the signed-in dashboard account.
The pre-test is an ungraded survey (background, topic experience, confidence) and is saved with no score.
Only the post-test knowledge-check MCQs are auto-scored (I don't know yet = 0).
Suggested time: about 10 minutes per test. Do not show the answer key until both tests are complete.

pre_test.question: Which best describes your current role?
pre_test.sectionIntro: This pretest is not graded, and there are no right or wrong answers. It tells us who you are, what you have already worked with, and how confident you feel about each training topic, so we can adjust the sessions. Please answer honestly. Suggested time: about 10 minutes.

post_test.question: Why is the command line especially useful for data analysis and bioinformatics?
options: It only works with small files that can be opened manually
It makes every task graphical and mouse-driven
It supports fast, reproducible, and scalable workflows
It automatically corrects every command before running it
post_test.sectionIntro: Choose the one best answer. Select "I don't know yet" instead of guessing if you are unsure. Suggested time: 10 minutes.
